description: Schedule H (large plan) or Schedule I (small plan) financial line items for a retirement / benefit plan, looked up by employer EIN + plan number (+ plan year) with no Ack ID needed. Returns employer, participant and total contributions, income, benefits paid, administrative expenses, assets and liabilities, plus every stored DOL line by its DOL column name. Source: U.S. Department of Labor, EBSA, Form 5500 Schedule H/I datasets (stored copy; data_as_of and loaded plan years in every response). Omit plan_year for all stored years, newest first. A plan that filed a Form 5500-SF has neither schedule.

ein.description: Employer Identification Number (9 digits, dashes optional).

plan_year.description: Plan year (e.g. 2022). Omit for every stored plan year.

name: form5500_schedule

items.description: One Schedule H or Schedule I record.

dol_fields.description: Every stored line by DOL column name.

line_items.description: Headline lines by friendly name; absent when the filer left the box blank.

title: Form5500 Schedule
